skills.name: Blink Step
skills.description:
Step through the gap.
Instantly teleports you to the aimed spot.

skills.name: Clear Sky
skills.description:
Nothing between you and the mark.
Raises your accuracy for a long while.

skills.name: Cloud Cover
skills.description:
Hard to see, harder to hit.
After casting Updraft, your evasion rises for a moment.

skills.name: Cloudburst
skills.description:
Celestia's rain, wherever she drifts.
A rain cloud follows you, firing a volley each swing on everything close to you — each hit a basic attack. When it ends, every Gathering Clouds stack becomes one more volley.

skills.name: Fair Weather
skills.description:
A clear sky opens when you need it.
When your HP drops low, Updraft is ready again at once and your evasion rises.

skills.name: Gathering Clouds
skills.description:
The sky thickens with every shot.
Each basic attack that lands adds a stack of accuracy, up to a limit. Cloudburst spends them for extra volleys.

skills.name: Gust Front
skills.description:
Move on with the wind.
When you kill something, you move faster for a while.

skills.name: Hailstone
skills.description:
Draw, hold, release.
A heavy shot with extra crit chance, and more still against a slowed target.
effects: Deals **2.85×** physical damage, +**25%** crit chance, +**25%** more crit chance against a slowed target

skills.name: High Cirrus
skills.description:
Thin, fast and far above.
You move and attack faster for a short while.

skills.name: Jet Stream
skills.description:
A narrow wind at the top of the sky.
A shot that pierces in a straight line, hitting every enemy it passes.

skills.name: Low Cloud
skills.description:
Weigh their steps down.
A shot that slows the target.

skills.name: Nimbus
skills.description:
Wrap yourself in cloud.
When you take damage, your evasion rises for a moment.

skills.name: Overcast
skills.description:
Darken their sky.
Cuts the target's accuracy for a while.

skills.name: Petrichor
skills.description:
The smell after rain.
Every hit that lands while Cloudburst rains makes the rain last a little longer, up to a limit.

skills.name: Rain Shadow
skills.description:
Strike from where they are not looking.
After casting Updraft, your next few basic attacks hit harder.
effects: Your next **3** basic attacks deal +**17%** damage within **5s**

skills.name: Rainbow
skills.description:
An arc that lands where they will be.
An arrow lobbed onto a spot lands a moment later on everything around it, harder the farther each enemy is from you.
effects: Deals **0.08×** physical damage, **12×** hits, +**0.004×** per metre to the target

skills.name: Scattered Rain
skills.description:
One drop becomes three.
A shot that splits to more enemies nearby.

skills.name: Slipstream
skills.description:
Ride the air they missed.
When you dodge an attack, your next few basic attacks can't miss.
effects: Your next **3** basic attacks can't miss within **3s**

skills.name: Sun Shower
skills.description:
Rain in the sunlight.
A burst of quick shots, each a basic attack.

skills.name: Silver Lining
skills.description:
Light through a moving cloud.
A shot that hits twice, harder the more movement speed bonus you have.
effects: Deals **0.59×** physical damage, **2×** hits, +**0.005×** per 1% movement speed bonus

skills.name: Thunderhead
skills.description:
The storm gathers into one strike.
A heavy shot, harder the further your hit chance goes past a sure hit, up to a limit.
effects: Deals **9.3×** physical damage, +**0.075×** per point of hit chance above 100% (up to 100)

skills.name: Updraft
skills.description:
Rise and drift away.
Dash to a nearby spot, in any direction.

skills.name: Wandering Sky
skills.description:
The cloud nobody could catch.
Your evasion and movement speed rise until a hit costs you health. Every attack you dodge meanwhile is answered with an arrow.

skills.name: Wandering Sky

skills.name: Ashfall
skills.description:
The sky turns to ash.
Burning stones fall around the aimed spot in several strikes, each hitting harder for every Stone on its target. Leaves no mark. Opens with a high Fire Orb level.
effects: Deals **0.23×** magic damage, **+0.11×** magic damage for every Stone on the target (left in place)

skills.name: Brushfire
skills.description:
Wind feeds the fire.
The aimed ground burns. Every second, a gust of hot wind hits everything standing in it and adds a Burn.

skills.name: Deluge
skills.description:
Water puts out the fire.
A flood sweeps the aimed area and puts out every burn. Each burn put out lands the damage it had left, at once.
effects: Puts out the target's burn, and the burn damage it had left lands at once, ×**1.5**

skills.name: Ground Strike
skills.description:
Earth swallows the spark.
Grounds the Static on every enemy around you. Each Static discharges as a hit, then becomes a Stone.
effects: Grounds the target's Static: **+0.4×** magic damage per stack
Their next attack deals −**20%** damage within **10s** — one for every Static the target carried, only on one that carried any

skills.name: Dust Devil
skills.description:
The wind stands up and walks.
A whirlwind follows you, striking everything near you, more strikes the faster you cast. Each strike hits harder for every Chill on its target. Leaves no mark. Opens with a high Wind Orb level.
effects: Deals **0.45×** magic damage, **+0.08×** magic damage for every Chill on the target (left in place)

skills.name: Eruption
skills.description:
The mountain wakes.

The ground erupts, and an ash cloud over the aimed area makes every mark on the enemies in it last longer, and stronger.
effects: Every Burn on the target lasts **10s** longer and grows **20%** stronger
Every Stone on the target lasts **10s** longer and grows **20%** stronger
Every Static on the target lasts **10s** longer and grows **20%** stronger
Every Chill on the target lasts **10s** longer

skills.name: Geyser
skills.description:
Fire under stone boils the water.
Steam bursts where you stand and throws you to the aimed spot, and bursts again where you land.

skills.name: Hoarfrost
skills.description:
Frost on the wind.
A gust hits every enemy around you, then carries the Chill on each one to every enemy next to it.
effects: Carries the target's Chill to every enemy within **2.5m**, never past its own count — each slows **15%**

skills.name: Earthquake
skills.description:
The mountain shakes.
The aimed ground quakes again and again, each quake hitting harder for every Static on each enemy. Leaves no mark. Opens with a high Earth Orb level.
effects: Deals **0.49×** magic damage, **+0.05×** magic damage for every Static on the target (left in place)

skills.name: Meteor
skills.description:
Fire melts the stone.
A flaming stone lands on the aimed spot and melts the Stone on its target, for bonus damage per Stone.
effects: Melts the target's Stone: **+0.5×** magic damage per charge

skills.name: Obsidian
skills.description:
Molten stone hardens again.
Melts the Stone on every enemy around you into lava, a hit for each Stone melted. The lava then hardens on them as Stone.
effects: Melts the target's Stone: **+0.4×** magic damage per charge
Their next **3** attacks deal −**20%** damage within **10s** — only on a target that carried Stone

skills.name: Earth Orb
skills.description: Stone that fire left behind. Holds an Earth orb: defence while a Staff is in hand.
effects: Holds one **Earth** orb: +**4%** defence while a Staff is in hand (three orbs at most, the oldest drops)

skills.name: Fire Orb
skills.description: A spark of the turning world. Holds a Fire orb: magic attack while a Staff is in hand.
effects: Holds one **Fire** orb: +**4%** magic attack while a Staff is in hand (three orbs at most, the oldest drops)

skills.name: Water Orb
skills.description: Water that wears the stone. Holds a Water orb: max MP while a Staff is in hand.

skills.name: Wind Orb
skills.description: Air that lifts the sea. Holds a Wind orb: cast speed while a Staff is in hand.
effects: Holds one **Wind** orb: +**4%** cast speed while a Staff is in hand (three orbs at most, the oldest drops)

skills.name: Permafrost
skills.description:
The ground freezes through.
The aimed ground freezes: every enemy on it gains a Chill every second. It deals no damage while it lasts, so a freeze it makes holds. When it ends, the ground cracks and hits everything on it.
effects: Adds **1** Chill for **4s** — each slows **15%**, **3** freeze for **10s**. Not on a burning target

skills.name: Release
skills.description:
The cycle turns.
Casts the combination your three orbs make. Hold three orbs first.

skills.name: Erosion
skills.description:
Water and wind wear the stone.
Wears down every enemy in the aimed area: a hit, a cut to their magic defence, and their MP drained into yours.
effects: Drains up to **10** MP and gives it to you

skills.name: Sandstorm
skills.description:
Earth grounds the storm.
Sand buries the aimed area and grounds the Static on each enemy, for bonus damage per Static.
effects: , **19×** hits. Grounds the target's Static: **+0.02×** magic damage per stack

skills.name: Scald
skills.description:
Steam.
Puts out the burns on every enemy around you. Each burn put out becomes a scalding hit, then a Chill.
effects: Puts out the target's burn: **+0.4×** magic damage per burn stack
Adds **1** Chill for **4s** — each slows **15%**, **3** freeze for **10s**. Not on a burning target — only on a target that carried Burn

skills.name: Heat Lightning
skills.description:
A storm on a hot wind.
A thundercloud hangs over the aimed area: every second its heat lightning strikes everything under it and adds Static.
effects: Adds **2** Static for **10s** — each cuts attack speed **2%**, up to **5**

skills.name: Stalactite
skills.description:
Stone that water made.
Drips fall on one enemy, one after another. Each drip hits and adds a Stone.
effects: Their next attack deals −**20%** damage within **10s**

skills.name: Weathering
skills.description:
Sun, rain and wind.
Ends the cooldown of the last combination you cast, ultimates included, and a burst of weather hits the aimed area.
effects: The last combination you cast is ready again at once, ultimates included

skills.name: Whiteout
skills.description:
The world goes white.
A blizzard beats on the aimed area, growing with your max MP and hitting harder for every Burn on each enemy. Leaves no mark. Opens with a high Water Orb level.
effects: Deals **0.42×** magic damage, +**0.0008×** per point of your max MP (up to +2×), **+0.1×** magic damage for every Burn on the target (left in place)

skills.name: Windshear
skills.description:
Wind scatters the ice.
Blades of wind cut the aimed area and scatter the Chill on each enemy, for bonus damage per Chill. A frozen enemy shatters.
effects: Scatters the target's Chill: **+0.4×** magic damage per stack, a frozen target shatters as **6**

skills.name: Summon
skills.description: Calls up this creature's summons, up to as many as its kind keeps out at once.

skills.name: Thousand Petals
skills.description:
Become the storm.
Arms dance charges and half as many parries, both sized by how fast you swing. Each beat spends a charge to flash to a new angle and strike, hunting a new target nearby. Every charge still held adds damage.
effects: Parries the next hit within **8s** — no damage taken

skills.name: Held Breath
skills.description:
Take it now, pay it later.
Arms charges for a short window. Each holds back one incoming hit and banks the damage instead of paying it in health; the whole bill lands at once when the window ends.
effects: Delays the next **5** hits within **4s** — the delayed damage all lands at once when the window ends

skills.name: Howling Wind
skills.description:
Force one enemy to fight you.
Taunts one enemy for a while: locked onto you, no skills, no pause between swings.

skills.name: Single Petal
skills.description:
Wind up and commit.
A slow, telegraphed heavy blow.

skills.name: Eye of the Storm
skills.description:
A read pays for the next one.
After a parry, your MP returns faster for a moment.

skills.name: Last Petal
skills.description:
Everything, in one swing.
One massive blow that spends every Rising Breeze stack you hold, hitting harder for each.

skills.name: Stripped Bough
skills.description:
Blunt their swing.
A strike that makes their next attack land weaker.
effects: Their next attack deals −**40%** damage within **6s**

skills.name: Second Bloom
skills.description:
The dance goes on.
A kill during Thousand Petals adds more dance charges.

skills.name: Tailwind
skills.description:
Stay on one foe.
Every basic attack grants extra Rising Breeze equal to a third of your unbroken run of hits on that target.

skills.name: Still Air
skills.description:
Weather it.

Shrugs off poison, bleed and burn, heals part of your max HP, then raises your defence and magic defence for a while.

skills.name: Bare Branch
skills.description:
Cornered, you hold the line.
Dropping to low HP arms more Held Breath charges.

skills.name: Crossed Branches
skills.description:
No escape.
Casting Piercing Gust gives a charge for a moment. The next basic attack you start on a target within Piercing Gust's range spends it to lunge at it again.

skills.name: Piercing Gust
skills.trigger: When you start a basic attack
skills.description:
Close the distance.
Dashes to the target and strikes. With Crossed Branches, casting it also arms a charge.

skills.name: Rising Breeze
skills.description:
Every hit adds up.
Each basic attack that lands grants a stack of extra damage.

skills.name: Scattered Petals
skills.description:
Break their rhythm.
A strike that slows their attack speed.

skills.name: Petal Storm
skills.description:
Don't let up.
Arms stacks of extra damage, then spends them as real basic attacks, two per swing — so every blow feeds Rising Breeze.

skills.name: Parting Clouds
skills.description:
Find the weakness.
A parry has a chance to charge your next attack with extra damage — spent whether it hits or misses.
effects: **50%** per hit: your next attack deals +**100%** damage within **5s**

skills.name: Squall
skills.description:
Go faster, fragile.
Raises your attack speed for a while, but you lose defence and magic defence at the start.

skills.name: Bending Reed
skills.description:
Read the hit and punish it.
Fully negates the next few incoming hits.
effects: Parries the next **2** hits within **3s** — no damage taken

skills.name: Headwind
skills.description:
Never let them recover.
Every hit cuts the target's HP regen for a while, and the cuts stack.

skills.name: Returning Wind
skills.description:
Answer all of it at once.
Cashes the damage Held Breath banked: several strikes, each landing your attack plus a share of the banked total, and the debt is erased. With an empty bank it still casts, landing plain attacks.
effects: Deals **1.38×** physical damage, **5×** hits **+ 2.5 × banked total**

skills.name: Deep Roots
skills.description:
Stand your ground.
After casting Still Air, nothing stops you for a moment — no flinch, stun, freeze, silence, knockback or pull.
effects: Nothing stops you for **3s** — no flinch, stun, freeze, silence, knockback or pull, and hits can't cancel your casts

skills.name: War Banner
skills.description: Raise a rallying banner so you and nearby allies deal more damage for a while.
